item.title: Pipeline Surfers Had LOTS to Be Thankful for on Thanksgiving
item.description: If you're an American, yesterday was Thanksgiving. It's a time to reflect on the things in your life that you're thankful for. Things like Pipeline.

item.title: Dylan Graves Sets Guinness World Record For
item.description: The wave was surfed in 2023, and Guinness World Records finally confirmed the world record turns/carves. Dylan Graves has had his eyes on it since 2011.

item.title: Meet the Divers Retrieving
item.description: Ghost Diving USA is a nonprofit dedicated to removing lost fishing equipment, known as "ghost gear," from the ocean floor that can trap marine mammals and fish.

item.title: Australian Man Pleads Guilty To Manslaughter After Killing Surfer Over $50
item.description: The killer of a former competitive surfer in Manly, Australia, has pleaded guilty to manslaughter after a dispute over just $50 that turned brutally violent.

item.title: Honolulu Fire Department Begs Public to Respect the Power of the Ocean
item.description: The Honolulu Fire Department warned beachgoers on the North Shore of Oahu to stay out of the water if they were in any way unsure of their capabilities.

item.title: Albee Layer Just Got One of the Best Rides at Jaws We
item.description: There's still an entire season to go, so it's hard to imagine that Albee Layer won't paddle into an even better ride this winter. But this'll be in the running.

item.title: Jamie O
item.description: Jamie O'Brien has a new brand dropping foam surfboards built for Pipeline. Part of a good brand is the testing phase, and there's no better test pilot than him.

item.title: Video: Local Tenerife Surfer Attacks Tourists With Rocks
item.description: Venezuelan tourists encountered a hostile local on Tenerife, the largest of the Canary Islands. As depicted in a video, the situation escalated to violence.

item.title: Clay Marzo Is an Absolute Master of the Backside Barrel
item.description: Clay Marzo is, for this author's money, the best surfer on the planet. His backside tube riding is on full display here at a Wavegarden wave pool in Spain.

item.title: More Than 1,000 River Surfers Rode Munich’s Wave Pool for Free While the Eisbach Is Unrideable
item.description: When the famed Eisbach disappeared in early November because of a city-run dredging project, O2 SURFTOWN MUC offered free sessions to river surfers.
